evidence.reduce_strategy: Content distribution reduced without policy violation - 'reduce' pillar of remove/reduce/inform
evidence.ranking_ai: AI systems inform ranking for Facebook Feed, Instagram Reels, Facebook Marketplace
evidence.transparency_ranking: Limited disclosure of ranking signals; 'Our approach to explaining ranking' published but no per-user visibility
evidence.shadow_ban: Content demoted in distribution without notification or appeal
evidence.oversight_board: External appeals body for content decisions; limited to select cases

impact.description: Systematic shadow banning via 'reduce' strategy: content algorithmically deprioritized without policy violation, notification, or appeal path. Ranking AI for Feed/Reels/Marketplace uses undisclosed signals. Oversight Board handles only select cases.

remediation.notes: Transparency Center provides aggregate reports but no individual visibility
